candidate_name: JERA Montenegro LNG terminal + gas-fired power plant (feasibility-stage)
sponsor_or_proposer: JERA Co. (Japan) with Montenegro Ministry of Energy and Mining
current_state: MOU signed at Gastech 2025 (11 Sep 2025) to run a comprehensive feasibility study; multiple potential locations under analysis (not yet pinned to Port of Bar). No FID, no fixed site, no capacity.
missing_threshold_elements: No confirmed location (study covers several sites), no concrete construction step, no committed sponsor equity beyond MOU/feasibility.
watch_for: Feasibility-study outcome, site selection (whether it lands at Bar or elsewhere), and whether it supersedes/merges with the existing LNG Alliance Bar LNG record.
notes: Likely the live successor pathway to the stalled LNG Alliance/EPCG Bar proposal. If sited at Bar, may eventually map onto T100000131102; if elsewhere, a new record. Verified secondary: https://balkangreenenergynews.com/montenegro-plans-to-develop-lng-terminal-with-jera/
